title: Enrichment of Polyadenylated RNA for Nanopore Direct RNA Sequencing
author: Paul MK Gordon
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.88ahzse
materials: Oxford Nanopore Technologies Direct RNA sequencing kit

In the same tube, perform 3h or overnight restriction digest according to the NEB protocol for your enzyme, e.g. http://nebcloner.neb.com/#!/protocol/re/single/Taq1 (65C for Taq1, 37C for the other 5 restriction enzymes) The longer incubation is suggested due to the lower efficiency of RNA:DNA restriction compared to DNA:DNA. Step 5 can be performed while you wait for the incubation to finish.
After the 3 hour incubation has finished, perform the RNeasy MinElute Cleanup Kit protocol (spin column) on the contents of the NEB enzyme reaction tube.

steps.title: Synthesize required oligos
steps.instruction: Order or synthesize the three oligos (RE oligo, RTA oligo A, and RTA oligo B) using open‑source design software and your reference sequence data.

steps.title: Add RNA and RE oligo
steps.instruction: In a 1.5 mL tube, add up to 2 µg of total RNA (in ≤10 µL) and 1 µL of 1 µM RE oligo.

steps.title: Heat mixture to 80 °C
steps.instruction: Heat the tube to 80 °C for 2 min, then allow it to cool slowly at a rate of 0.1 °C per second.

steps.title: Prepare or retrieve RTA duplex
steps.instruction: Obtain a duplex of standard RTA oligo A and custom RTA oligo B for downstream ligation.

substeps.instruction: If this is the first use of the custom oligos: in a new tube, mix RTA oligo A and custom RTA oligo B 1:1 to a final concentration of 1.4 µM in buffer (10 mM Tris‑HCl pH 7.5, 50 mM NaCl); heat to 95 °C for 2 min and cool slowly at 0.1 °C/sec to form the duplex.
If the custom oligos have been used before: retrieve the previously prepared RTA duplex from storage.

steps.title: Run ONT Direct RNA sequencing kit
steps.instruction: Perform the Oxford Nanopore Technologies Direct RNA sequencing protocol (RNA‑002 kit) on the RNA isolated with the MinElute kit, following the manufacturer’s checklist.

steps.title: Add RTA duplex to RNA
steps.instruction: Add 1 µL of the RTA duplex to the tube containing the eluted RNA; store any remaining duplex for future use.

steps.title: Incubate at 80 °C
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture for 10 min at 80 °C.
